chunks.text: The chip decides how much power a miner needs for each unit of work. Newer number, less power. ⏱ 1-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Live prices. ⚡ Short answer. Each newer chip uses less electricity per TH/s in our data. More chips = more hashrate, not better efficiency. Most boards on sale use the BM1370. The BM1373 is the newest we see in shops. A Bitaxe Naja Duo (BM1373) uses about 36% less power than a Bitaxe Gamma (BM1370) for the same hashrate.

Which chip does the Bitaxe Gamma use? One BM1370, like most current Bitaxe and NerdQaxe boards. What does J/TH mean? Joules per terahash: electricity per unit of work. Lower is better. Should I wait for a newer chip? Newer chips use less power, but don't always cost less per TH/s. Cheap power: buy on price per TH/s. Expensive power: buy on J/TH. Is a BM1366 Bitaxe Ultra still worth buying? Only if it's cheap. It uses noticeably more power per TH/s than a BM1370 board. Why are these numbers different from my miner's dashboard? They're sellers' stated figures. Real numbers depend on frequency, voltage, cooling and power supply.

Firmware is the software inside your miner: it runs the chip, the fan and the dashboard. Here's which one to run. ⏱ 1-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Releases checked Oct 28, 2026. ⚡ Short answer. Bitaxe: run the official AxeOS. NerdAxe, NerdQaxe, NerdOCTAXE, NerdQX: run the official NerdQAxe firmware. Custom builds like AxeForge? Open source only, downloaded from the project's own GitHub.

🟧 AxeOS (ESP-Miner) The official firmware every Bitaxe ships with. Start here. Runs on: Bitaxe boards 102 to 801, plus 1201 (Naja Duo) and 1300 (Gamma Hex). Open source (GPL-3.0). Latest v2.15.4 (Oct 21, 2026). Install with the web flasher (Chrome or Edge, USB). Miners we track: Bitaxe Gamma, Bitaxe GT 801, Bitaxe Naja Duo, Bitaxe Gamma Hex. 🟦 NerdQAxe firmware The official firmware for the Nerd*axe family. Runs on: NerdAxe, NerdAxe Gamma, NerdQAxe+, NerdQAxe++, NerdOCTAXE, NerdQX, NerdEKO, NerdHaxe Gamma. Open source (GPL-3.0). Latest v1.1.0.1 (Sep 24, 2026). Install with the web flasher (Chrome or Edge, USB). Miners we track: NerdQaxe++, NerdOCTaxe Gamma, NerdQX. 🧪 AxeForge A new custom firmware with its own screen layouts. Small and young project, so expect changes. Runs on: NerdQaxe++ only. Open source (GPL-3.0). Latest v1.4.2 (Oct 28, 2026).

Latest v1.4.2 (Oct 28, 2026). Miners we track: NerdQaxe++. 🎲 NerdMiner v2 A lottery-ticket toy: it mines on the ESP32 itself, so its hashrate is tiny. Fun to learn on, not to earn. Runs on: Plain ESP32 dev boards (LILYGO T-Display S3 and others), no mining chip. Open source (MIT). Latest V1.8.3 (Sep 13, 2025). From each project's GitHub page, checked Oct 28, 2026. New versions come out often.

Which firmware should I run on my Bitaxe? Official AxeOS. Pick the file matching your board number (601 or 602 for a Gamma). Which firmware runs on a NerdQaxe++? The official NerdQAxe firmware from shufps. AxeForge is a newer community option. Can I put AxeOS on a NerdQaxe? No. Use the firmware made for your board. How do I know my firmware has no hidden fee? Install it yourself from the project's GitHub releases page and set your own pool and address. Will updating erase my settings? A dashboard update keeps them. A full USB flash can reset them, so write them down.

Do I need an app to monitor my Bitaxe? No. Type its IP address into a browser on the same Wi-Fi. Apps add alerts and a phone view. How can I check my Bitaxe when I'm not home? Free: look up your address on your pool's page (public-pool.io, solo.ckpool.org). Or HashWatcher's Hub, or Bitaxe Baller Pro alerts. Should I open a port on my router to reach my miner? We wouldn't. The dashboard has no password, so anyone could change your pool. Will an app slow down my miner? No. They only read the stats the miner already reports. Which app works with the Avalon Nano 3S? Of these five, HashWatcher. The others are built for AxeOS miners.

Are these our measurements? No. They're the maker's or a shop's stated figures, with the source labeled. How loud is 40 dB? A quiet library. Under about 35 dB suits a bedroom; over 50 dB is garage territory. Are Bitaxe Gamma boards quiet? Most owners find them fairly quiet, but no shop publishes a dB figure, so we don't list it. Small Bitaxe boards run on 5 volts. Bigger ones run on 12 volts with a different plug. The wrong one can damage the board. ⏱ 2-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Live prices. ⚡ Short answer. 5V: Bitaxe Gamma, Gamma Duo, Nerdaxe Gamma (round barrel plug). 12V: Bitaxe GT 801, Naja Duo, NerdQaxe++ (yellow XT30 plug). Never swap them. Size it above the draw: a Gamma (≈20 W) needs about 4 A, so a 6 A supply is plenty.

Round barrel = 5V. Yellow XT30 = 12V. (Gamma Hex: 6-pin. Avalon Nano 3S: USB-C.). chunks.section: Cheapest with the power supply in the box
chunks.text: In-stock listings that say the supply is included, checked Nov 27, 2026 6:37 AM ET. 80% of a 350 W supply = 280 W. NerdOCTaxe Gamma + NerdQaxe++ 240 W. + a Bitaxe Gamma Hex 380 W. Stated: NerdOCTaxe Gamma ≈160 W, NerdQaxe++ ≈80 W, Bitaxe Gamma Hex ≈140 W. Two fit; a third goes over. 🔁 Same voltage only 12V boards only on a 12V brick. Never feed a 5V board like the Bitaxe Gamma from a 12V rail. 📊 Stay under 80% Of the continuous rating, 24/7. ≈240 W of boards wants 300 W or more. 🔌 Wall watts vs dashboard watts A wall meter often reads 15–20% higher. Size from the higher number. 🧯 Mind the power strip Check its continuous rating, not just the surge number. General guidance (Nov 3, 2026). Overclocking draws more.

Can I use a phone charger for my Bitaxe Gamma? No. It needs a steady 5V supply with a 5.5 × 2.1 mm barrel plug and about 4 A or more. Can I plug a 12V supply into a 5V Bitaxe? No. 12V can damage 5V boards, and a 5V supply won't run 12V (XT30) boards. Can several miners share one power supply? Yes, if they share a voltage and stay under about 80% of the continuous rating. A NerdOCTaxe plus a NerdQaxe++ (≈240 W) wants about 300 W or more. How big a power supply should I get? At least a quarter more than the stated watts, more if you overclock. Do all shops include the power supply? No. The table above only counts listings that say it's in the box.

Get it on Wi-Fi, point it at a pool that pays your Bitcoin address, and check it's running right. ⏱ 2-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. AxeOS checked Oct 29, 2026. ⚡ Short answer. Join the miner's own setup Wi-Fi, then give it your home Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz only). In Pool settings, replace the User field with your own Bitcoin address. Do the backup pool too. After 10 minutes, check shares are going up and the hashrate looks normal.
🔑 Your Bitcoin address From a wallet you own. 📶 Wi-Fi password 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. 🔌 Its own power supply 5 V or 12 V. Which? 🌬️ Airflow Fan side clear.

When you first plug it in, the screen shows a setup Wi-Fi name and a QR code. 1 📲 Join its setup Wi-Fi Plug in. Scan the QR code or join Bitaxe_XXXX (no password). 2 📶 Add your home Wi-Fi Pick your 2.4 GHz network and save. The screen shows its new IP address. 3 🏊 Set pool + your address Type the IP in a browser → Pool. Default: Public Pool (public-pool.io, port 21496), backup Solo CKPool (solo.ckpool.org, port 3333). Put your address in User on both. 4 ✅ Check it's mining Shares climb within minutes. After 10 minutes a Gamma averages near 1.07 TH/s at stock.

Why can't my Bitaxe find my Wi-Fi? It only works with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. If it can't see your network, turn on a separate 2.4 GHz network in your router. What do I put in the User field? Your own Bitcoin address, optionally plus a miner name (youraddress.bitaxe1). Password: usually x. Do I need an account with the pool? Not for Public Pool or Solo CKPool: your address is your login. Braiins asks you to sign up. How do I find my Bitaxe's dashboard later? Type the IP address from its screen into a browser on the same Wi-Fi. My Bitaxe is on, but the hashrate is 0. What's wrong? Usually a typo in the pool address or port, or it's not on Wi-Fi yet. Check Pool settings and save.

The heat isn't wasted: use one power bill twice, for warmth and for mining. Example: an Avalon Mini 3's heat costs about $61/mo instead of $88 for a space heater. A heat pump is usually still cheaper heat.

Can a Bitcoin miner heat a room? Yes. Nearly every watt becomes heat, so a 1,000 W miner warms a room like a 1,000 W heater. Is a heater miner cheaper than a space heater? Usually a little: same heat for the same power, plus a small pool payback. Is a heater miner cheaper than a heat pump? Usually not at typical US power prices. The US Department of Energy says a heat pump uses about half the electricity for the same warmth. What about summer? Without a need for heat, the power is just a mining cost. Most owners turn them down or off.

Tiny miners usually go solo, heater miners join a shared pool, and hybrid pools sit in between. ⏱ 2-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Pools checked Oct 26, 2026. ⚡ Short answer. Bitaxe: solo on Public Pool (no fee) or Solo CKPool (2% of a block you find). Heater miner: a shared pool like Braiins (daily payouts) or OCEAN. The pool never changes your odds. It only decides who gets paid what.
🎟 Solo Whole block reward, or nothing. 🤝 Shared Everyone splits every block, minus a fee. 🎯 Hybrid Big prize for the finder, shares for the rest. Solo vs pool, in one picture →.

Pool: Public Pool; Type: Solo (also a shared mode); Fee: No fee; How you get paid: Solo: if your miner finds a block, the reward goes straight to your Bitcoin address. Pool: Solo CKPool; Type: Solo; Fee: 2% of a block you find; How you get paid: Only if your miner finds a block, paid to your address. No account needed. Pool: Parasite Pool; Type: Hybrid; Fee: No fee; How you get paid: The miner that finds a block gets 1 BTC. The rest is split by work done since the pool's last block, paid over Lightning. What is the best mining pool for a Bitaxe? Most Bitaxe owners mine solo on Public Pool (no fee) or Solo CKPool (2% of a block you find). Parasite Pool is a middle ground. Which pool should a heater miner use? Usually a shared pool. Braiins (FPPS) pays daily; OCEAN pays from its blocks once you pass its threshold. Does the pool change my chance of finding a block? No. That depends on your hashrate versus the network. The pool only decides how rewards are shared. Can I switch pools? Yes, anytime. It's a setting in your miner. Set a fallback pool too. Do I need an account? Not for Public Pool, Solo CKPool or OCEAN: your Bitcoin address is the username. Braiins uses an account.

It's an electric space heater that mines Bitcoin while it warms your room. ⏱ 2-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Live prices. ⚡ Short answer. Nearly every watt becomes heat. A 1,000 W miner warms a room like a 1,000 W space heater. While it heats, it mines. In a pool it pays a little back. Bedroom, kids or pets? Treat it like any space heater. Safety basics ↓.

chunks.section: Safe in a bedroom, or around kids and pets?
chunks.text: Same rules as any electric space heater ( US CPSC ): 🔌 Straight into the wall No extension cord or power strip. Big units on their own circuit. 📏 3 feet of clear space Keep beds and curtains back. Never cover the vents. 😴 Off while you sleep The CPSC's advice for any space heater. Warm the room first, or use a timer. 🧒 Kids and pets Somewhere it can't be knocked over or blocked. Supervise small children. 🤫 Pick a quiet one Low stated dB or a night mode for bedrooms. 📘 Follow the manual The maker's placement and circuit guidance comes first. Stated noise: Heatbit Canvas: no fans, so it runs silent (maker-stated); Heatbit Trio: up to about 45 dB stated; Avalon Mini 3: about 33–55 dB stated, by mode. Full noise table.
💸 Cover your whole bill Earnings move with Bitcoin's price. No promises. ♨️ Beat a heat pump A heat pump makes more heat per watt. ☀️ Pay off in summer No heat needed = paying just to mine.
📐 Size 300–800 W: small or medium room. 1,500 W: a full space heater on high. ⚡ Circuit A US 15 A, 120 V circuit carries about 1,440 W continuously. 📦 Stock Many sell out before winter.

Is a Bitcoin heater miner safe in a bedroom? Use it like any electric space heater: wall outlet, 3 feet of clear space, vents uncovered. The US CPSC advises turning space heaters off while you sleep, so warm the room first or use a timer. Are heater miners safe around kids and pets? Treat it like a space heater: put it where it can't be knocked over or blocked, keep cords out of reach, and supervise small children. Does a heater miner heat as well as a space heater? Yes, watt for watt. Nearly all the electricity becomes heat. Will it pay my heating bill? Part of it at best, and nothing is guaranteed.

Is home Bitcoin mining worth it? Usually not for the money at typical US power prices. It can make sense with very cheap power, as a heater you'd run anyway, or as a hobby and lottery ticket. What electricity price makes mining break even? It depends on the miner. For the miners here it's roughly $0.04 to $0.07 per kWh today, and it moves with Bitcoin's price and difficulty. Does a heater miner save money? Only against electric heat you'd use anyway; then mining is a small rebate. A heat pump or gas is usually cheaper heat.

chunks.section: Hashrate too low? Try these in order

Why is my Bitaxe Gamma under 1.2 TH/s? At stock (525 MHz) the firmware expects about 1.07 TH/s. Listings quoting 1.2+ assume a higher frequency. Check the 10-minute average. What temperature is normal for a Bitaxe? The auto fan aims for 60°C. Above 75°C on the chip, or 105°C on the regulator, it stops mining. What does the error percentage mean? Work that came back wrong. Small is normal; high or rising usually means too hot or too little voltage. Does a higher best difficulty mean I'm closer to a block? No. Every share is a fresh draw. Is a used Bitaxe worth it? If it hits the stock numbers, runs official firmware and costs well under new. Re-enter the pool settings yourself.

Yes, solar can run a miner. A Bitaxe needs one panel. A big heater-size miner needs a whole roof. ⏱ 2-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Live prices. ⚡ Short answer. Yes. Solar can run any miner. The only question is how many panels. A Bitaxe Gamma (≈18 W) needs 1 panel. An Avalon Mini 3 (≈800 W) needs about 14. Mining at night? Add a battery. Otherwise mine in daylight only.

Sun → panel → battery (only for nights) → miner. Bitaxe Gamma ≈18 W 1 panel. NerdQaxe++ ≈80 W 2 panels. NMQAxe++ Nexus ≈110 W 2 panels. Avalon Nano 3S ≈140 W 3 panels. Hammer Thor P2 ≈166 W 3 panels. Avalon Mini 3 ≈800 W 14 panels. Heatbit Maxi ≈1,500 W 27 panels. Avalon Q ≈1,674 W 30 panels. Panels for 24/7: one 400 W panel × 4 sun hours × (1 − 14% losses) ≈ 1.38 kWh a day, rounded up. US sun hours: about 3 to 6.5 a day ( map ); 14% losses is NREL PVWatts ' default. Winter makes less.

☀️ Daytime only No battery, cheapest. Fewer hours, so it earns less. 🔋 24/7 with a battery Mines all night. Batteries cost money and lose a little energy. 🏠 Rooftop solar already? Compare your spare power's value with each miner's break-even price.

Can a solar panel run a Bitaxe? Yes. A Bitaxe draws about 15 to 25 W, so one home panel is plenty in daylight. For nights, add a battery or a small power station. Can I mine only when the sun is out? Yes. It just mines fewer hours, so it earns less and gets fewer solo chances. Is solar mining free? Not quite. Panels and batteries cost money, and power you could use or sell has value. It's best with spare power you can't sell for much. How many panels does a big home miner need? Watts × 24 hours ÷ what one panel makes a day. At about 1.38 kWh per 400 W panel, a 500 W miner needs about 9 panels plus a battery for 24/7.

Every miner can run one of two ways. One is a lottery ticket, the other a small, steady paycheck. ⏱ 1-min read. Updated Nov 27, 2026. Live prices. ⚡ Short answer. Solo: find a whole block yourself (about 3.125 BTC plus fees) or get nothing. Pool: share the work with thousands of miners and get small, regular payouts, minus a fee. Tiny miners usually go solo. Heater miners usually pool. You can switch anytime.
